name: PLC input / output
summary: A controller interface point connecting field signals to an identified module channel.
description: A PLC input or output point connects a field signal with a controller module and channel. Input and output, digital and analogue, and one-wire or multi-wire arrangements are distinct characteristics. The module specification establishes electrical behaviour and terminal information.

A schematic should connect channel identification to the I/O schedule and field device. Shared supplies, commons and isolation boundaries require their own documentation. A generic controller box is not a pinout or wiring instruction for a particular module.
readingNotes: Identify module, channel and signal direction.
Use the selected module documentation to interpret supply, common and terminal requirements.
drawingChecklist: Identify signal type and channel reference.
Link module terminals and field-device documentation.
distinction: An input point, output point and communications connection are different interfaces. A generic box cannot establish their electrical compatibility.
